Irene / Laura — attaching initial redlines (tracked changes) and a short summary of my positions. High-level areas to note for Sparrow:

Attachment: Sparrow_MSA_v3_redlines.docx (docx)

Summary of key redlines / positions:
- Term: we accept a two-year renewal but request auto-renewal only if mutually agreed (proposal: no automatic renewal; customer to opt-in 60 days prior).
- Indemnity & IP: limited carveouts; we will not accept unlimited indemnity for third-party claims tied to customer data misuse.
- Data retention & residency: commit to primary residency in US region; backups may be stored in a secondary region with encryption at rest — require a written SOC2-backed control statement.
- SLA & Credits: propose a cap on cumulative credits at 30% of monthly fees; payment remedy only, no uptime-based termination except for repeated breaches (3 events in 12 months).
- Audit rights: allow periodic SOC2 evidence and scoped audits with advance notice and cost allocation if it's an intensive onsite review.
- Order form: added a new table for burst capacity and overage pricing; requested Laura to confirm pricing bands align with the commercial proposal.

I'll be conservative where customer obligations could create open-ended exposure. Laura — once you update the order form I'll fold it into the doc and we can share with Sparrow.

- Aditya

Procurement: We need clarity on the definition of "event" and monitoring/measurement. Also want to understand whether credits are issued per impacted tenant or per account. Can Redwood supply a sample SLA computation table?

Procurement: We can accept the primary-US residency as long as backups are also guaranteed to be within US-EAST or US-WEST, not EU. Can you confirm that?

I've attached our PO template for completeness.

Thanks — looping procurement (procurement@sparrowhealth.com) for timeline.

Hi Sara / Tom — thanks for the quick review and the PO template. We pulled the internal threads together and below is a consolidated position and a proposed narrow MAP to keep things on track for Jan 26 sign-off.

Consolidated positions (Redwood):
- Term: willing to do 2-year with an auto-renewal clause that allows Sparrow a 60-day opt-out prior to renewal; Redwood requests a price-notice window and a cap of +10% in year 2 unless otherwise agreed.
- SLA: we'll provide a sample SLA computation table attached and clarify definition of "event" (single incident impacting >=5% of requests across the account). Credits will be applied at the account level, not per tenant, and capped at 30% of monthly fees.

- Audit rights: scoped, remote evidence by default; onsite audits require advance notice and cost sharing for extensive reviews.
- Order form: Laura will finalize the order form with explicit burst tiers and overage pricing; Marissa will confirm billing proration and invoicing cadence.
